messages:
maria: Hey team — customer (ACME Payments) opened a support ticket: after our cert rotation last night SLO flows fail. Users click logout, we redirect to IdP, IdP redirects back and then 302 loop. They say session cookie isn't cleared on our domain. Repro steps: login via SSO -> click logout -> infinite redirect.
support-alex: can you paste a minimal repro curl and any logs you saw?
maria: curl -v -L 'https://sp.acme-payments.com/saml/slo?SAMLRequest=...' 
maria: server response headers from our edge:
```
HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: https://idp.acme-idp.com/saml/slo?SAMLRequest=...&RelayState=abc123
Set-Cookie: __Host-session=eyJ...; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=None; Domain=.redwood.example.com; Path=/
```
vikram: that Set-Cookie Domain looks suspicious — SP host is `sp.acme-payments.com` but cookie Domain is `.redwood.example.com`. If the session cookie is scoped to our platform domain it won't be visible for the customer's SP hostname.
infra-jen: we rolled the cert + a small config change to the edge hostnames during the deploy last night. there was a backend change that normalized host for cookies to the platform domain (to support multi-tenant cookies). maybe that unintentionally flipped domain for proxied SPs.
sre-bot: deploy:edge-service v4.12.0 rolled at 2026-03-12T03:12:40Z by infra-jen — config flag `cookie_domain_override=true` enabled.
vikram: also check RelayState — customer said it sometimes disappears after the roundtrip. if our CDN or a redirect strips query params, IdP will come back without RelayState and SP won't map the logout to the right session.
maria: here's a full request/response trace (sanitized):
```
-> GET /saml/slo?SAMLRequest=...&RelayState=abc123 Host: sp.acme-payments.com
<- 302 Location: https://idp.acme-idp.com/saml/slo?SAMLRequest=...
<- Set-Cookie: __Host-session=...; Domain=.redwood.example.com
-> browser follows IdP -> returns to https://sp.acme-payments.com/saml/slo (no RelayState param)
-> SP can't find session -> redirects back to IdP -> loop
```
support-alex: repro is clear. immediate mitigation options:
- roll back the `cookie_domain_override` flag on edge (quick) OR
- make cookie domain dynamic so proxied host gets cookie for their own domain (safer)
- add a temporary sticky param in RelayState to reconstruct session if missing (hacky)
vikram: long-term fix: cookie issuance should respect the original Host header or the SP's configured `sp_base_url`. for Private/Dedicated customers we should never override cookie domain.
infra-jen: rolling a hotfix to disable cookie_domain_override in staging now, will canary to prod region by region. also adding a guard in config to not change cookie domain for proxied SPs. ETA for prod canary: ~30m.
maria: passing this to customer now. asking them to test after canary. noted suggestion to also check CDN redirect rules for querystring preservation.
support-alex: update ticket with the rollback plan and ask customer for a test window. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
